title: pkix-ct Error missing Send+Sync compile-time assertion
description:
pkix-ct::Error is auto-Send+Sync (all variants are value types) but lacks the `const _: fn() = || { fn _assert_send_sync<T: Send + Sync>() {} _assert_send_sync::<Error>(); };` block that every other substantive crate (pkix-path, pkix-revocation, pkix-chain, pkix-aia, pkix-truststore, pkix-lint, pkix-zlint-bridge) uses to pin the invariant.

AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6: public result/error types 'MUST be Send + Sync'. The auto-derivation satisfies this today, but a future field addition (e.g. an `Rc<T>` or raw pointer) would silently break it without a compile-time sentinel.

The compile-time assertion is a one-line workspace-standard pattern that costs nothing and prevents a class of silent regressions.

Location: /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-ct/src/lib.rs (no Send+Sync assertion block present)
